test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_has_const_u64 (id UInt64, a Array(UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE perf_has_const_long (id UInt64, a Array(UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE perf_has_const_nullable (id UInt64, a Array(Nullable(Int32))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE perf_has_const_decimal (id UInt64, a Array(Decimal64(2))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE perf_has_const_u16 (id UInt64, a Array(UInt16)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE perf_has_const_mixed_any (a Array(UInt64)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE perf_has_const_mixed_all (a Array(UInt64)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE perf_has_const_front (a Array(UInt64), f Array(Float64)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE perf_has_const_front_mixed (a Array(UInt64), b Array(UInt8)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE perf_has_const_short_rows (a Array(UInt64)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_has_const_u64 SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> cityHash64(number, x) % 100000, range(number % 10)) FROM numbers(10000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
INSERT INTO perf_has_const_long SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> cityHash64(number, x) % 1000, range(number % 50)) FROM numbers(4000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1

INSERT INTO perf_has_const_nullable SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> if(cityHash64(number, x) % 10 = 0, NULL, toInt32(cityHash64(number, x) % 100000)), range(number % 10)) FROM numbers(10000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
INSERT INTO perf_has_const_decimal SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> toDecimal64(cityHash64(number, x) % 100000, 2), range(number % 10)) FROM numbers(10000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
INSERT INTO perf_has_const_u16 SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> toUInt16(cityHash64(number, x) % 60000), range(number % 20)) FROM numbers(10000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1

INSERT INTO perf_has_const_mixed_any SELECT if(number % 65536 < 16, arrayMap(x -> toUInt64(100000 + x), range(10)), arrayPushBack(arrayWithConstant(100, toUInt64(100000)), 0)) FROM numbers(262144) SETTINGS max_block_size = 65536, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO perf_has_const_mixed_all SELECT if(number % 65536 < 16, range(toUInt64(128)), arrayConcat(range(toUInt64(4)), arrayWithConstant(196, toUInt64(100000)))) FROM numbers(262144) SETTINGS max_block_size = 65536, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO perf_has_const_front SELECT arrayWithConstant(64, number % 2), arrayWithConstant(64, toFloat64(number % 2)) FROM numbers(262144) SETTINGS max_block_size = 65536, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO perf_has_const_front_mixed SELECT if(number % 65536 < 64, arrayWithConstant(128, toUInt64(199)), arrayWithConstant(128, toUInt64(1))), arrayWithConstant(128, toUInt8(1)) FROM numbers(262144) SETTINGS max_block_size = 65536, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO perf_has_const_short_rows SELECT arrayConcat(range(toUInt64(4)), arrayWithConstant(496, toUInt64(100000))) FROM numbers(131072) SETTINGS max_block_size = 65536, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
test.query: SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_u64 WHERE hasAny(a, arrayMap(x -> x * 97, range(600)))
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_u64 WHERE hasAny(arrayMap(x -> x * 97, range(600)), a)
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_u64 WHERE hasAll(range(1000), a)
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_long WHERE hasAny(a, arrayMap(x -> x * 1009, range(600)))
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_long WHERE hasAll(range(1000), a)
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_long WHERE hasAll(a, range(32))
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_nullable WHERE hasAny(a, arrayMap(x -> toInt32(x * 97), range(600)))
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_nullable WHERE hasAll(arrayPushBack(arrayMap(x -> toInt32(x), range(1000)), NULL), a)
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_nullable WHERE hasAny(arrayPushBack(arrayMap(x -> toInt32(x * 97), range(600)), NULL), a)
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_decimal WHERE hasAny(a, arrayMap(x -> toDecimal64(x * 97, 2), range(100)))
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_u16 WHERE hasAny(a, arrayMap(x -> toUInt16(x * 97), range(100)))
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_mixed_any WHERE hasAny(a, range(toUInt64(600)))
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_mixed_all WHERE hasAll(a, range(toUInt64(128)))
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_front WHERE hasAll(range(toUInt64(600)), a)
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_front WHERE hasAll(arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), range(600)), f)
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_front_mixed WHERE hasAll(range(toUInt64(200)), a)
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_front_mixed WHERE hasAll(arrayMap(x -> toUInt8(x), range(200)), b)
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_short_rows WHERE hasAll(a, arrayMap(x -> toUInt64(x % 300), range(1024)))
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_u64 WHERE hasAny(a, range(8))
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_const_long WHERE hasAny(range(16), a)
